results.message: Can I make a one-on-one tech appointment?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: Yes, individual support is offered by appointment. You can schedule a 1-on-1 tutoring session for extra help with material from a training you've attended, or for help with a topic not covered in the regular training schedule. There are also Tech Time office hours and clinic sessions available by appointment. To schedule, use the Schedule an appointment option on the Individual Support page.
